name: 14607 · Rochester, NY
findings: ZIP 14607 (Rochester) has 175 nonprofit organizations. 108 of them (62%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 93 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (17% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 14607 (Rochester) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 14607 (Rochester) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.9 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 60 organizations here; 24% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
